name: COMP_032
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (70%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
Benign stays in the 90% conformal set; invasive probability is under 1% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 70%, Benign 15%, Normal 15% | Clear lead, not decisive |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% level) | Two classes unresolved |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.92 / 0.74 | No reliability flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models agree on class |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu | Moderate neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 6, 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · Lower invasive likelihood; spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Duct-confined atypia** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Lower invasive likelihood; spot check 12/20 [F4] · Weak
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 4, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Higher invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Small upward term · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Benign versus InSitu is unresolved; the 90% conformal set keeps both.
- 2 of 5 similar cases, including the closest (Normal), disagree with InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 5, 9**: Confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts; mitosis and necrosis scores are unreliable.
2. **7**: Look for stromal invasion; the validated invasion concept peaks here.
3. **8**: Corner segment alone crosses the margin threshold [F7]; highest regional invasive probability (12%).
